title: Completed original scalar-Hessian theorem for every finite r at least three quarters
statement: Completed SOLO PRODUCER Theorems A/B claim:for EVERY finite real r>=3/4,EVERY symmetric mean M,EVERY real periodic W2,4 psi on ANY flat2Dtorus,with unrestricted amplitude/concentration/support,H_r(S)=J_r([[q,w],[-sigma p,-sigma q]])/(kappa sigma^2),C_r=-p^2q-q^3/sigma^2,P_(r,nu)=H_r+C_r+nu p^2 obeys <P_(r,1)(M+D2psi)> >=P_(r,1)(M). sigma=r+1,kappa=r(r+2)/3;J_r unchanged. At M0,ALL real amplitude scalings yield ORIGINAL discriminant kappa<q^3+sigma^2p^2q>^2<=4sigma^2<p^2><J_r(V)>,including degenerate cases. Every zero-mean actual vector gradient U=sigma f_x+g_y=0 has stream f=psi_y,g=-sigma psi_x modulo constants,so full compatible U0class,not characteristic/two-wave subset. Proof supplies exact closed-form correction/primitive,positive12x12Gram via64degree31+48degree23Bernsteinblockchecks,margin2^-16;heat/Stokes monotonicity,smooth long-time limit and W2,4mollification. Parameter t=1/r,d0=(1+t)^2(2+t)(1+2t)^2(3+2t)^2/2700,E=t(1+t)^2(2+t),D=dE^2;d=d0 on[0,1],d=t^2d0 on[1,4/3];actual t>0. TheoremB Frobenius actual-field gap of H_r>= [|M|^2<|D2psi|^2>+<|D2psi|^4>]/[201326592(1+r^4)]. Source-reported final replay .373094083s,112matrices;not coordinator/Capital rerun or new independent audit. GeneralU,0<r<3/4andfullaffineQC/Morrey remain unresolved. A later completed source-informed coordinator assessment reads the full proof and reruns BOTH producer-authored checkers against frozen completed inputs:112 parameter-matrix checks and the exact small-r heat obstruction pass. It assesses the continuum finite-r>=3/4 compatible-field theorem,all-background scalar-Hessian QC,all-mean sharp coefficient,non-Hessian-polyconvexity,leading coercivity and actual ordinary-heat method obstruction at their stated scopes. This is substantive internal acceptance from an informed coordinator with prior exposure,not a blind or independently authored audit. It is a NEW receipt distinct from the earlier64-check interim run and does not identify every prior producer-executed byte. No Capital science replay or new correctness investigation was performed.
